annotation.speech2: Four pictures on a two by two grid, each drawn to the same scale on its own pair of axes. Shape one, top left, is the triangle lying above the line y equals x and below the line y equals r. Shape two, top right, is the triangle lying below y equals x and to the left of the line x equals r. Shape three, bottom left, is the sector of the circle of radius r between the line y equals x and the positive y axis. Shape four, bottom right, is the sector of the same circle between the line y equals minus x and the negative x axis.
Shape one, the triangle above the line y equals x, where the absolute value of y is at least the absolute value of x.
Shape two, the triangle below the line y equals x, where the absolute value of x is at least the absolute value of y.
Shape three, the circular sector between the line y equals x and the y axis, where the absolute value of y is at least the absolute value of x.
Shape four, the circular sector between the line y equals minus x and the negative x axis, where the absolute value of x is at least the absolute value of y.
